mapper.select: SELECT M.MEMBER_ID AS memberId, M.MEMBER_NAME AS memberName, MD.COMMUNITY_NICKNAME AS communityNickname, U.UNIV_NAME AS univName, D.DEPT_NAME AS deptName, M.STATUS AS status, M.CREATED_AT AS createdAt FROM MEMBER M LEFT JOIN MEMBER_DETAIL MD ON M.MEMBER_ID = MD.MEMBER_ID LEFT JOIN UNIVERSITY U ON M.UNIV_ID = U.UNIV_ID LEFT JOIN DEPARTMENT D ON MD.DEPT_ID = D.DEPT_ID WHERE M.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}

SELECT ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM POST P WHERE P.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND P.IS_DELETED = 0 ) AS postCount, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM POST_COMMENT C JOIN POST P ON C.POST_ID = P.POST_ID WHERE C.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND C.IS_DELETED = 0 AND P.IS_DELETED = 0 AND P.IS_BLIND = 0 ) AS commentCount, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM POST_LIKE L JOIN POST P ON L.POST_ID = P.POST_ID WHERE L.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND P.IS_DELETED = 0 AND P.IS_BLIND = 0 ) AS likedPostCount, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PRODUCT P WHERE P.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND P.IS_DELETED = 0 ) + ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T.PRODUCT_ID) FROM TRADE_CHAT_ROOM T JOIN PRODUCT P ON T.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID WHERE T.BUYER_ID = #{memberId} AND P.IS_DELETED = 0 ) AS tradeCount, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PRODUCT_LIKE L JOIN PRODUCT P ON L.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID WHERE L.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND P.IS_DELETED = 0 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PRODUCT_REPORT PR WHERE PR.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID) < 5 ) AS wishlistCount FROM DUAL

SELECT C.COMMENT_ID AS commentId, P.POST_ID AS postId, C.CONTENT AS content, P.TITLE AS postTitle, P.BOARD_ID AS boardId, B.BOARD_NAME AS boardName, C.CREATED_AT AS createdAt FROM POST_COMMENT C JOIN POST P ON C.POST_ID = P.POST_ID JOIN BOARD_TYPE B ON P.BOARD_ID = B.BOARD_ID WHERE C.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND C.IS_DELETED = 0 AND P.IS_DELETED = 0 AND P.IS_BLIND = 0 ORDER BY C.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT P.POST_ID AS postId, P.TITLE AS title, P.BOARD_ID AS boardId, P.CREATED_AT AS createdAt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM POST_LIKE PL WHERE PL.POST_ID = P.POST_ID) AS likeCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM POST_COMMENT PC WHERE PC.POST_ID = P.POST_ID AND PC.IS_DELETED = 0) AS commentCount FROM POST_LIKE L JOIN POST P ON L.POST_ID = P.POST_ID WHERE L.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND P.IS_DELETED = 0 AND P.IS_BLIND = 0 ORDER BY L.PRESSED_AT DESC

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT P.PRODUCT_ID AS tradeId, P.PRODUCT_ID AS productId, NULL AS roomId, P.PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, P.PRICE AS price, P.PRODUCT_STATUS AS status, '판매' AS role, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PRODUCT_REPORT PR WHERE PR.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID) AS reportCount, CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PRODUCT_REPORT PR WHERE PR.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID) >= 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS isBlind, P.CREATED_AT AS createdAt FROM PRODUCT P WHERE P.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND P.IS_DELETED = 0
UNION ALL
SELECT P.PRODUCT_ID AS tradeId, P.PRODUCT_ID AS productId, MIN(T.ROOM_ID) AS roomId, P.PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, P.PRICE AS price, P.PRODUCT_STATUS AS status, '구매' AS role, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PRODUCT_REPORT PR WHERE PR.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID) AS reportCount, CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PRODUCT_REPORT PR WHERE PR.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID) >= 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS isBlind, MIN(T.CREATED_AT) AS createdAt FROM TRADE_CHAT_ROOM T JOIN PRODUCT P ON T.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID WHERE T.BUYER_ID = #{memberId} AND P.IS_DELETED = 0 GROUP BY P.PRODUCT_ID, P.PRODUCT_NAME, P.PRICE, P.PRODUCT_STATUS ) ORDER BY createdAt DESC

SELECT P.PRODUCT_ID AS productId, P.PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, P.PRICE AS price, P.PLACE AS place, P.PRODUCT_STATUS AS status FROM PRODUCT_LIKE L JOIN PRODUCT P ON L.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID WHERE L.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND P.IS_DELETED = 0 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PRODUCT_REPORT PR WHERE PR.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID) < 5 ORDER BY L.PRESSED_AT DESC
SELECT MIN(D.DEPT_ID) FROM MEMBER M JOIN DEPARTMENT D ON D.UNIV_ID = M.UNIV_ID WHERE M.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
mapper.update: MERGE INTO MEMBER_DETAIL MD USING ( SELECT #{memberId,jdbcType=NUMERIC} AS MEMBER_ID, #{communityNickname,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS COMMUNITY_NICKNAME, ( SELECT MIN(D.DEPT_ID) FROM DEPARTMENT D JOIN MEMBER M ON M.UNIV_ID = D.UNIV_ID WHERE M.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId,jdbcType=NUMERIC} ) AS DEPT_ID FROM DUAL ) SRC ON (MD.MEMBER_ID = SRC.MEMBER_ID) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET MD.COMMUNITY_NICKNAME = SRC.COMMUNITY_NICKNAME WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (MEMBER_ID, DEPT_ID, COMMUNITY_NICKNAME) VALUES (SRC.MEMBER_ID, SRC.DEPT_ID, SRC.COMMUNITY_NICKNAME)
